info.title: Mass Polimer ERP API
info.description:
REST API for the Mass Polimer ERP: the manufacturing value chain from customer
inquiry through order, production plan, shift logbook, quality inspection,
finished-goods stock and dispatch, plus the complaint/CAPA loop that closes
back onto it.

**This document is generated from the running server.** Paths, methods, request
bodies, authentication and the permission each route is gated on are read from
the live Express router stack and the Zod schemas that validate the requests, so
they cannot drift from what is enforced.

### Conventions

- Base path `/api`. Request and response bodies are JSON.
- Every failure uses the same envelope: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details?" } }`.
  Branch on `error.code`, which is stable; `message` is for humans.
- Writes are validated with Zod and return `422` with a field-level error map on failure.
- Lifecycle transitions are their own endpoints (`/orders/{id}/cancel`,
  `/logbooks/{id}/submit`, `/capas/{id}/close`) and are transactional where they
  touch several tables.
- Every request is scoped to the caller's organization; there is no way to read
  or write another tenant's rows.
- Response schemas come from the Prisma datamodel. Where an endpoint includes a
  relation, the nested object may carry only the fields that endpoint selects.

### Authorization

Authentication establishes *who* you are; each route additionally requires a
feature permission, listed in its description as **Requires permission**. Roles
map to permissions server-side — the client's own checks are cosmetic only.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Liveness and the caller’s own identity.

tags.name: Sales
tags.description: Customers, inquiries, quotations and sales orders — the head of the value chain.

tags.name: Planning
tags.description: Scheduling confirmed orders onto a machine, shift and date.

tags.name: Manufacturing
tags.description: Shift logbooks and the templates that shape them. A logbook may only be opened against a scheduled plan.

tags.name: Quality
tags.description: Roll inspection. A pass books finished-goods stock, which is what makes a roll dispatchable.

tags.name: Dispatch
tags.description: Shipping produced orders: dispatch record, invoice and the finished-goods stock movement.

tags.name: Inventory
tags.description: Ledger-derived stock balances plus raw-material receive and issue.

tags.name: CAPA
tags.description: Customer complaints against dispatched batches and the corrective/preventive actions that close them out.

tags.name: Maintenance
tags.description: Machine registry and the preventive maintenance schedule.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: Aggregated KPIs for the per-role home screens.

tags.name: Administration
tags.description: Employees, roles and per-employee screen access.

tags.name: Legacy
tags.description: The data.json blob store still backing domains not yet migrated to Postgres. Being retired domain by domain.
